candidates.source_name: Erste Group Bank AG — Press Releases (news-media)
candidates.why_relevant: Erste Group announces Slovenska sporitelna (SLSP) CEO/CFO appointments in English at group level, typically same-day or ahead of the SLSP Slovak newsroom. Confirmed example: 11 Aug 2025 release naming Michaela Bauer CEO of Slovenska sporitelna from March 2026, succeeding Peter Krutil.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly HTML crawl of the dated press-release index (URL pattern /en/news-media/press-releases/YYYY/MM/DD/slug); filter titles for Slovensk*, SLSP, Slovakia, CEO, management board.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query + snowball from search result
queries_used: Erste Group investor relations ad-hoc announcement Slovenská sporiteľňa CEO appointment

candidates.source_name: Erste Group — Investor Information / IR news feed
candidates.why_relevant: Regulated investor-information stream (quarterly results, ad-hoc, segment reporting). Slovakia is one of Erste's seven core markets and is a reported segment, so headcount, branch count (160 branches cited) and segment restructuring appear here before local comms.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl IR news index quarterly + on results dates; pull linked results PDFs and extract Slovakia segment employee/branch tables.
queries_used: Erste Group capital markets day 2026 presentation Slovakia segment restructuring hub

candidates.source_name: Erste Group — Management Board / corporate governance page
candidates.why_relevant: Actor map anchor: group board members and their country/segment responsibilities. Changes here cascade into who signs off Slovak subsidiary appointments; useful for diffing over time.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly snapshot + text diff of the roster.
queries_used: Erste Group investor relations ad-hoc announcement Slovenská sporiteľňa CEO appointment

candidates.source_name: Intesa Sanpaolo — Price sensitive press releases (Investor Relations)
candidates.why_relevant: Parent of VUB Banka (approx. 96.97% stake). Price-sensitive releases carry Danube Hub / international subsidiaries division restructurings, capital actions and results in English; historically also Slovak JV and stake announcements.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl dated archive (pattern /en/investor-relations/press-releases/YYYY/MM/...); keyword filter VUB, Vseobecna uverova banka, Slovakia, Danube.
queries_used: Intesa Sanpaolo investor relations press release VUB Banka Slovakia management change

candidates.source_name: Intesa Sanpaolo — Newsroom / all news (group)
candidates.why_relevant: Non-price-sensitive group communication where subsidiary CEO profiles and interviews appear (e.g. interview with the then-new VUB Slovakia CEO Jozef Kausich). Good for confirming role scope and strategy framing behind an appointment.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly crawl with VUB/Slovakia keyword filter.
queries_used: Intesa Sanpaolo investor relations press release VUB Banka Slovakia management change

candidates.source_name: Raiffeisen Bank International AG — Investor Relations / ad-hoc releases
candidates.why_relevant: RBI fully consolidates Tatra banka. RBI ad-hoc releases cover management board changes and network restructuring; RBI network pages document the Slovak entity's place in group structure.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl IR news/ad-hoc index; mirror via EQS ad-hoc feed as redundancy; filter Tatra, Slovakia, Bratislava.
queries_used: Raiffeisen Bank International investor relations Tatra banka ad hoc release board appointment

candidates.source_name: EQS News — ad-hoc announcements (Austrian/DACH issuers incl. RBI, Erste)
candidates.why_relevant: Distribution wire carrying the legally mandated ad-hoc text verbatim, machine-friendly and often indexed before the issuer site is re-crawled. Confirmed example: RBI ad-hoc appointing Kamila Makhmudova as CFO to the Management Board.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll issuer-filtered ad-hoc listing daily; store full text + timestamp as the authoritative first-publication time.
queries_used: Raiffeisen Bank International investor relations Tatra banka ad hoc release board appointment

candidates.source_name: OeKB Issuer Information Center (OAM Austria)
candidates.why_relevant: Austria's officially appointed mechanism (OAM) storing regulated information for Erste Group and RBI. It is the legally complete archive that feeds the Wiener Boerse ad-hoc page, so it backstops anything deleted from a corporate site.
candidates.source_subtype: officially appointed mechanism / regulated info storage
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Issuer-scoped search for Erste Group Bank AG and RBI AG; archive PDF/HTML with publication timestamps.
queries_used: Wiener Börse ad-hoc disclosure Erste Group RBI issuer announcements page officially appointed mechanism Austria

candidates.source_name: Wiener Börse — Ad-hoc News
candidates.why_relevant: Exchange-side consolidated ad-hoc feed for ATX issuers (Erste Group, RBI). Simple to poll and gives a single chronological stream covering two of the three biggest Slovak bank owners.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily HTML poll of the ad-hoc listing; filter issuer = Erste Group Bank / Raiffeisen Bank International.
queries_used: Wiener Börse ad-hoc disclosure Erste Group RBI issuer announcements page officially appointed mechanism Austria

candidates.source_name: KBC Group Newsroom
candidates.why_relevant: KBC owns CSOB Slovakia and, since 15 Jan 2026, 365.bank (98.45% bought from J&T Finance Group for EUR 761m). KBC states the next step is a legal and operational merger of CSOB and 365.bank — the single largest driver of Slovak banking headcount, branch and leadership change in this run's window. Also announced the CSOB Leasing / Business Lease deal (closed Feb 2026) and the 2020 OTP Banka Slovensko integration.
candidates.source_subtype: parent group newsroom / press release archive
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl of newsroom index with Slovak keyword filter (Slovakia, CSOB, 365.bank, Postova banka); also fetch the PDF variants under kbc.com/content/dam/kbccom/doc/newsroom/pressreleases/.
queries_used: KBC Group investor relations press release ČSOB Slovakia reorganisation
OTP Group investor relations Slovakia exit OTP Banka Slovensko divestment announcement

candidates.source_name: KBC Group — Investor Relations (results, presentations, company presentations)
candidates.why_relevant: Deal-specific investor presentations (e.g. the 365.bank acquisition deck) carry integration timelines, synergy targets and implied FTE/branch consolidation for Slovakia — the leading indicator for redundancies and hiring freezes at CSOB SK.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly PDF harvest of results presentations and any M&A decks; extract Slovakia segment FTE, branch and cost-synergy slides.
queries_used: KBC Group investor relations press release ČSOB Slovakia reorganisation

candidates.source_name: GlobeNewswire / Nasdaq — KBC Group regulated releases
candidates.why_relevant: KBC disseminates regulated information via GlobeNewswire/Nasdaq; these mirrors are timestamped, stable and easy to poll, and survive newsroom restructures.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily issuer-filtered poll; deduplicate against newsroom.kbc.com by title hash.
queries_used: KBC Group investor relations press release ČSOB Slovakia reorganisation

candidates.source_name: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia — Debt Investor Relations
candidates.why_relevant: The Slovak UniCredit business is a foreign-bank branch of the Prague-domiciled entity, so its governance, board and organisational disclosures live in Czech/English at unicreditbank.cz, NOT on a Slovak IR page. Prospectuses and annual reports name board members and describe the Slovak branch organisation.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Semi-annual PDF harvest of annual reports and base prospectuses; extract management-body sections and Slovak branch headcount.
queries_used: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia branch investor relations press release Slovakia

candidates.source_name: UniCredit S.p.A. — Group media/IR
candidates.why_relevant: Ultimate parent; group-level CEE reorganisations, country-manager appointments and cost programmes that reach the Slovak branch are disclosed here in English before any Slovak communication.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly crawl with Slovakia/Slovak/Bratislava/CEE keyword filter.
queries_used: UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia branch investor relations press release Slovakia

candidates.source_name: J&T Finance Group SE — For Investors
candidates.why_relevant: Former owner of 365.bank / Postova banka and current owner of J&T Banka's Slovak branch. As a bond issuer it publishes English consolidated annual reports naming statutory bodies and describing group restructuring — the counterparty view of the KBC deal and of what J&T retains in Slovakia.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual/semi-annual PDF harvest; parse governance and subsidiary-list sections.
queries_used: J&T Finance Group 365.bank investor relations bondholder disclosure English annual report

candidates.source_name: J&T Global Finance (bond issuance vehicles) — annual reports
candidates.why_relevant: Financing SPVs whose English annual reports disclose group structure changes and guarantor composition; an indirect but legally compelled window on J&T's Slovak perimeter after the 365.bank sale.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF pull.
queries_used: J&T Finance Group 365.bank investor relations bondholder disclosure English annual report

candidates.source_name: OTP Group — investor news archive
candidates.why_relevant: OTP exited Slovakia (sale of OTP Banka Slovensko to KBC, agreed Feb 2020, closed 27 Nov 2020), so this is now a historical/baseline source rather than a live channel. Keep on low-frequency watch in case of re-entry or CEE reshuffles touching Slovakia.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly keyword check for Slovak/Slovakia only.
queries_used: OTP Group investor relations Slovakia exit OTP Banka Slovensko divestment announcement

candidates.source_name: Slovenská sporiteľňa — English newsroom (subsidiary mirror of group release)
candidates.why_relevant: Subsidiary-side English mirror of Erste group announcements; publishing-time comparison between slsp.sk/en, slsp.sk/sk and erstegroup.com establishes the empirical lead-time of the parent channel — the core hypothesis of this cell.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Paired crawl of EN and SK news indexes with timestamp capture to measure parent-vs-subsidiary lead time.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cross-language pairing of the same event
queries_used: "ad hoc" oznámenie materská skupina banka Slovensko zmena predstavenstva vymenovanie generálny riaditeľ 2026

candidates.source_name: VÚB banka — international presence / group leadership page
candidates.why_relevant: Slovak-language subsidiary page describing VUB's place inside the Intesa Sanpaolo group and leadership framing; used to map group terminology (Danube Hub, divizia medzinarodnych dcerskych bank) onto Slovak wording so the English parent feed can be joined to sk-language reporting.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly snapshot; use for glossary/actor-map maintenance rather than event detection.
queries_used: "ad hoc" oznámenie materská skupina banka Slovensko zmena predstavenstva vymenovanie generálny riaditeľ 2026

candidates.source_name: MarketScreener — issuer profiles and board rosters (Tatra banka, KBC, Erste)
candidates.why_relevant: Aggregator carrying board-member rosters for Tatra banka (SK1110001502 is listed on BSSE) plus mirrored group presentations. Useful as a cheap diffable roster and as a fallback when a parent PDF is paywalled or moved.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-frequency lookup only; never a primary citation — always confirm against the issuer or the OAM.
queries_used: Raiffeisen Bank International investor relations Tatra banka ad hoc release board appointment

candidates.source_name: Prague Stock Exchange (PSE) — Erste Group dual listing page AT0000652011
candidates.why_relevant: Erste Group is dual-listed in Prague; the exchange page aggregates issuer announcements in English and gives a second, independent publication venue for regulated news relevant to the CEE/Slovak segment.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency poll as redundancy to Wiener Boerse.
queries_used: Erste Group capital markets day 2026 presentation Slovakia segment restructuring hub

candidates.source_name: EuropaWire — EU press-release distribution (bank group releases)
candidates.why_relevant: Carries verbatim English copies of Erste Group releases about Slovak subsidiary appointments and CEE divisional leadership (e.g. the Slovenska sporitelna CEO succession and a 2026 Central-Europe corporate-division head appointment), giving a searchable secondary index.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword RSS/search poll; treat as discovery aid only, cite the issuer original.
queries_used: Erste Group investor relations ad-hoc announcement Slovenská sporiteľňa CEO appointment

candidates.source_name: Erste Group Annual Report — Strategy & segment reporting (online edition)
candidates.why_relevant: Annual report segment chapters give the auditable Slovakia baseline: employees, branches, segment result and organisational structure. This is the denominator against which any announced headcount programme should be measured.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual harvest of the online report and PDF; extract the Slovakia segment tables into a time series.
queries_used: Erste Group capital markets day 2026 presentation Slovakia segment restructuring hub

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Erste Group 'Capital Markets Day' event page or deck focused on a Slovakia segment restructuring or a Bratislava hub relocation was found in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned only regular quarterly results presentations and earnings calls in which Slovakia is discussed as one of seven core markets; no CMD-specific Slovak restructuring material surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumes CMD decks are a leading indicator; for Erste the practical substitute is the quarterly results deck plus the annual report segment chapter, so collection design should not depend on a CMD cadence.

negative_findings.description: No Intesa Sanpaolo price-sensitive release specifically announcing a current VUB Banka management change was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: The IR press-release archive surfaced results releases and historical Slovak items (2002 IntesaBci-in-VUB anniversary, 2004 pension JV) plus a newsroom CEO interview, but no recent VUB board-change ad-hoc.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Suggests Intesa treats VUB executive appointments as non-price-sensitive and routes them to the newsroom or to VUB itself, so the Slovak-language cell may lead the English parent cell for this owner — the opposite of the cell's default assumption.

negative_findings.description: There is no Slovak-domiciled UniCredit issuer with its own IR channel.
negative_findings.result_summary: UniCredit's Slovak business has operated since Dec 2013 as a foreign-bank branch (pobocka zahranicnej banky) of UniCredit Bank Czech Republic and Slovakia, so disclosure sits at unicreditbank.cz and unicreditgroup.eu.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collector keyed to a Slovak UniCredit IR domain will find nothing; the branch structure must be encoded in the actor map or UniCredit SK leadership changes will be missed entirely.

negative_findings.description: OTP has no Slovak banking subsidiary.
negative_findings.result_summary: OTP Banka Slovensko was sold to KBC (agreed 17 Feb 2020, closed 27 Nov 2020) and merged into CSOB; OTP Group IR is therefore historical for SK.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The seed actor list includes OTP; keeping it at normal priority would waste collection budget. Demote to low-frequency watch.

negative_findings.description: No PPF Group ownership link to a Slovak bank or licensed payment institution was confirmed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searching the parent-owner set surfaced J&T Finance Group as the relevant Czech-domiciled owner (365.bank, J&T Banka SK branch); PPF did not appear as an owner of an SK bank in any result reviewed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: PPF appears in the cell brief paired with J&T; treating them as equivalent would create a phantom actor. PPF should be re-tested specifically against payments/consumer-finance entities rather than banks before being kept or dropped.

negative_findings.description: Slovak-language search returns almost no parent-group ad-hoc material.
negative_findings.result_summary: The sk query using 'ad hoc oznamenie / materska skupina / zmena predstavenstva / generalny riaditel' returned Slovak media and subsidiary newsrooms (slsp.sk, vub.sk, banky.sk, startitup.sk), not parent-group regulated disclosure.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms the cell's English-first design is correct and that it does not overlap the sk newsroom cell; but it also means sk terms are useful only for entity-name joins, not for finding parent disclosure.

negative_findings.description: The OeKB Issuer Information Center was not fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Its role as Austria's OAM feeding the Wiener Boerse ad-hoc page was established indirectly from search results; the portal itself and its search/export interface were not exercised.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: It is likely the highest-integrity archive for Erste/RBI regulated news; access mechanics (search UI vs. API, rate limits) must be tested before it can be designed into a collector.

coverage_gaps.description: Non-bank payment firms with foreign listed parents operating in Slovakia (acquirers, card schemes, PSPs, ATM operators) were not covered; the pass was bank-dominated.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map to payments parents with SK exposure (e.g. Worldline/Nexi-type acquirers, Global Payments-style JVs, Euronet's Slovak ATM/POS operations) and scout their English IR and 8-K/RNS-equivalent channels.

coverage_gaps.description: Group-level careers/HR channels of the parents were not scouted, only IR/press channels.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add parent-group careers portals and their Bratislava/Slovakia job feeds (Erste Group Careers, KBC/CSOB, RBI, Intesa) as a direct jobs signal complementing regulated disclosure.

coverage_gaps.description: The Belgian (FSMA/STORI) and Italian (CONSOB / eMarket SDIR-STORAGE) officially appointed mechanisms for KBC and Intesa were not identified, unlike Austria's OeKB IIC.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout and test the Belgian and Italian regulated-information storage mechanisms so all four main owners have an OAM-grade archival fallback.

coverage_gaps.description: The core premise — that parent English disclosure precedes Slovak subsidiary communication — is asserted but only anecdotally testable so far (the SLSP CEO case appears same-day on both erstegroup.com and slsp.sk).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a lead-time study over 10-20 paired events (parent release vs. subsidiary sk release vs. sk media) to set the real polling cadence and to decide whether this cell is a lead source or merely a redundant one per owner.

coverage_gaps.description: The Slovak supervisory side of appointments (NBS fit-and-proper approvals, which every appointment found is conditioned on) was out of this cell's scope and is unassigned here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Ensure another cell covers NBS/ECB approval registers and the Slovak Commercial Register (ORSR) so announced appointments can be tied to their effective legal date.

coverage_gaps.description: The CSOB / 365.bank legal and operational merger is the dominant forthcoming SK org-change event and currently rests on a single channel (KBC newsroom/IR).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a dedicated multi-channel watch for this merger: KBC IR + Belgian OAM + CSOB SK and 365.bank sk newsrooms + Antimonopoly Office (PMU SR) decisions, so headcount and branch consolidation is caught from several independent sides.

brief: Slovak banking is owned almost entirely from abroad, and the English parent-group layer is a genuinely productive channel: Erste (Slovenska sporitelna), Intesa Sanpaolo (VUB), RBI (Tatra banka), KBC (CSOB and, since Jan 2026, 365.bank), UniCredit (a Prague-domiciled branch, not an SK entity) and J&T Finance Group all publish English press releases, ad-hoc disclosures and segment reporting that name Slovak leadership and organisational change. The strongest live sources are the Erste and KBC newsrooms plus Intesa's price-sensitive archive, backstopped by wire and exchange mirrors (EQS, Wiener Boerse, OeKB's OAM, GlobeNewswire) that preserve the legally mandated text with reliable timestamps. Two structural corrections matter for collector design: OTP has had no SK bank since 2020, and UniCredit SK is a foreign-bank branch whose disclosure lives at unicreditbank.cz, so keying on Slovak domains would miss it entirely. The dominant near-term event to instrument is the announced legal and operational merger of CSOB Slovakia and 365.bank, which is where headcount, branch and executive change will concentrate.
